How much does it cost to run a desiccant dehumidifier?

A typical desiccant dehumidifier uses about 550 watts (300–700W depending on the model). Used for 8 hours per day, 7 days a week, for 6 months of the year, it costs about £1.16 per day and £211 a year at the current price cap rate.

Cost per day
£1.16
About £211 a year at 8 hours per day, 7 days a week, 6 months a year.

Standing charge not included.

Ways to cut the cost

  • Run it on the lowest setting that does the job.
  • Close curtains on the sunny side during the day.
  • Use a timer so it isn't left running in an empty room.

Questions

How much does it cost to run a desiccant dehumidifier per hour?

At 26.32p/kWh, a 550W model costs about 14p an hour while it's running.

How much does it cost to run a desiccant dehumidifier per year?

About £211 a year, based on 8 hours per day, 7 days a week, 6 months a year. Change the sliders above to match how you use yours.

Is the standing charge included?

No. You pay the standing charge every day whether or not the appliance is used, so it isn't part of the cost of running it.

How do I find my desiccant dehumidifier's actual power use?

Check the rating label, plug or manual for the wattage, or the energy label for kWh figures. A plug-in energy monitor shows exactly what it uses.
